info.title: OpenSalesTax
info.description: Open-source US sales tax calculation API. Free, self-hostable, contributor-driven. Calculation only -- not legal or tax advice.

get.description:
Return service health.

Reports the package version and a quick DB connectivity check.
Status is ``"ok"`` when everything responds; ``"degraded"`` if
the DB ping fails (the API still responds so monitors can
distinguish "service down" from "DB down").

List every US tax jurisdiction with its coverage tier.

Tier semantics (also in StateInfo schema):

- **0** -- unsupported. The catalog entry is returned but no
  module is loaded; calculation requests for these states will
  return zero with a "no jurisdictions found" note.
- **1** -- fully maintained. Module + taxability matrix +
  tests. Phase 1: MN, WI, AK, DE, MT, NH, OR.
- **2** -- rate-only via SST data with default taxability.
  Phase 1 ships this for the other 22 SST states after
  Section G2 lands.

Return the active jurisdictional rate stack for ``zip5`` (+ optional ``zip4``).

The combined rate is the sum of every jurisdiction's rate that
applies to the address on today's date. Empty
``jurisdictions`` array means the ZIP isn't covered by any
loaded state module's data.

400.description: Malformed ZIP code rejected by the lookup layer.

401.description: Missing or invalid X-API-Key (api_key auth mode only).

post.description:
Calculate sales tax for a list of line items at a given address.

Returns a per-line decomposition with the constitution-§13
disclaimer. Lines for non-taxable categories return ``tax=0``
with an explanatory ``note``. Unknown ZIPs return ``tax=0`` for
every line, also with a ``note`` -- the call doesn't fail.

401.description: Missing or invalid X-API-Key (api_key auth mode only).

example.disclaimer: Calculation only; not legal or tax advice. Verify against your state Department of Revenue before remitting.

lines.note: Clothing is non-taxable in Minnesota (Minn. Stat. 297A.67 subd 8).

CalculatedLineResponse.title: CalculatedLineResponse
CalculatedLineResponse.description:
One calculated line in the response.

Invariant: ``tax == sum(j.tax for j in jurisdictions)`` -- the
per-jurisdiction breakdown reconciles exactly with the line
total. Use the breakdown for accounting (state/county/city
splits); use ``tax`` for the customer-facing total.

database_connected.title: Database Connected
database_connected.description: True if the configured DATABASE_URL accepts connections.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Liveness + readiness signal for the API.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Dollar amount this authority contributes to the line's tax. Present only in /v1/calculate responses; omitted in /v1/rates.

JurisdictionRate.title: JurisdictionRate
JurisdictionRate.description:
One jurisdiction's contribution to the rate stack.

``tax`` is populated only when this object appears inside a
``/v1/calculate`` response (where a line amount exists). The
sum of per-jurisdiction ``tax`` values equals the line's
``tax`` exactly -- the engine quantizes per-jurisdiction first,
then sums.

category.title: Category
category.description: Tax category. Standard categories: general, clothing, groceries, prescription_drugs, prepared_food, digital_goods. Per-state taxability rules apply.

LineItemRequest.title: LineItemRequest
LineItemRequest.description: One taxable line in a calculate request.

example.disclaimer: Calculation only; not legal or tax advice. Verify against your state Department of Revenue before remitting.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 0 = unsupported (no module loaded); 1 = fully maintained (taxability matrix + tests); 2 = rate-only via SST data with default taxability.

StateInfo.title: StateInfo
StateInfo.description: One entry in the /v1/states coverage list.
